notes.title: The Time to Grow is Here! Growmancer Full Release
notes.notes:
It's finally here! Growmancer has now fully launched and is ready for you to play.

We can't wait to see what you think. If you enjoy your time with the game, please consider leaving a review. It helps more players like you discover Growmancer!

Enjoy the game!

P.S. Shout-out to Idle cub for the great idea in their video! As suggested, the pet can now get a cool firefighter helmet once you unlock the right upgrade. :)
